evidence.quote: This evening I would like to focus on these vulnerabilities and on how best we should address them.
we need to redouble efforts at genuine supervisory cooperation if we are to manage effectively the vulnerabilities and challenges posed by the perennial home-host issue.
The most important contribution the United States can make to global financial stability is to ensure the stability of our own financial system.
